source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the 1339 landing4e08c5a43b49d07a66cc0905a69e79899d5f9a9d, the counter follows an uncaught awaited addTargetCalendarItem call, so a rejection prevents that increment. At fixed0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, add errors are caught/logged before the counter, so failed attempts also count. All inspected revisions process an unchanged ETag when this.listener is present; changed/new is not the only entry condition. Current multiget yields after ten processed add attempts and resets; its separate WebDav loop uses25 handled responses, and network batch size is another control. This corrects the completed-addition wording in the two superseded focused lessons and only the yield sentence in evidence a1b3e31b83272ce2241f25d88d727cf1402325691fd6b8485afd350927610789. Broader queue/token/timer ownership findings in that note remain outside this correction. Static Git inspection only; no throughput or responsiveness test ran.
title: CalDAV multiget yield counts differ before and after add-error catching
